title: Security & Compliance | ContextMint
description: Security posture for ContextMint — local-first default, human apply gates, optional OIDC shared-server path. SOC 2 certification is roadmap.

hero.title: Defend AI-assisted development with evidence
hero.leadBefore: Local-first by default, human Gates 1 & 2 in the IDE, optional sovereign shared-server path with OIDC — built for security reviews of assisted development. We do

cards.title: Human gates (v1.0)
cards.text: Context Lens before inference. Patch preview and apply gates before repo writes. No silent auto-apply on the assisted path.

cards.title: Agent accountability
cards.text: Planned MCP tool logging and policy engine for agent assistants. v1.0 accountability is IDE gates + operator audit trails — not MCP production controls.

checklist.text: Local-first default — Engine + extension per developer (v1.0)
Shared on-prem API server — Docker / Helm pilot with platform ops
SSO (OIDC) and role-based access on the shared-server path
Operator audit / support-bundle export for pilot reviews
Path alignment required for shared server (Remote SSH or mounted monorepo)
Optional BYOK hybrid routing with egress redaction (off by default)
